column3: satyaṃ tvajjāra ityuktvā vihasansa tato muniḥ |
tāṃ vilokya tadaivākṣṇāṃ sahasraṃ bhavitā ca te |
itīndramapi tatkālaṃ śapati sma sa gautamaḥ ||
aśīlaṃ tasya nāma syān na khalīkārakāraṇam ||
yo yadvapati bījaṃ hi labhate so .pi tatphalam ||
yuvāṃ pūrvabhaginyau ca devyau śāpacyute ubhe |
devī vāsavadattā ca kṛtvā sādhāraṇaṃ patim |
udyogāyādhunā deva kauśāmbī kiṃ na gamyate |
satyaṃ tasyānupālyaṃ ca tvayā ca sa na vañcitaḥ |
mayā svayaṃ kṛtaṃ hyetanna ca tasyāsukhāvaham ||
cārebhyaśca mayā jñātaṃ yathā vikurute na saḥ |
bahunā kiṃ mayā sarvaṃ jñātuṃ prīto .smi ca tvayi |
tataḥ padmāvatīṃ rājñyā samānāyya samaṃ tayā |
taṃ dattaprābhṛtaṃ dūtaṃ sa saṃmānya vyasarjayat ||
dhanyā vāsavadattā tu tvadbhaktyā tatkṛtaṃ tayā |
na ca vāsavadattāto bhinnā padmāvatī mama |
etan nijaśvaśuradūtavaco niśamya vatseśvarasya hṛdaye sapadi pramodaḥ |
devyāṃ ca ko.pi vavṛdhe praṇayaprakarṣo bhūyāṃś ca mantrivṛṣabhe praṇayānubandhaḥ ||
tatastaṃ devībhyāṃ samamucitasatkāravidhinā kṛtātithyaṃ dūtaṃ sarabhasamanāḥ preṣya muditam |
vidhāsyannudyogaṃ tvaritamatha saṃmantrya sacivaiḥ sa cakre kauśāmbīṃ prati gamanabuddhiṃ narapatiḥ ||
tato lāvāṇakāt tasmād anyedyuḥ sacivaiḥ saha |
sā pravāsāgate patyau tatkālaṃ śuśubhe purī ||
iti vāsavadattāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā smṛtvā ca tattathā |
diṣṭyā na lajjitā devī sapatnyā sakhitulyayā |
mantriṇāṃ saṃnidhau vipro dvāri cakranda kaścana ||

column5: sa papraccha tataḥ so .pi tasmai vṛttāntam abravīt ||

column3: deva gopālakā bhūtvā krīḍāmo vijane vayam |
asmanmadhye ca kenāpi tasyājñā na vilaṅghyate |
evaṃ gopālako .raṇye rājyaṃ sa kurute prabho ||
adya caitasya viprasya tanayas tena vartmanā |
mā gās tvam apraṇamyeti rājādeśena jalpataḥ |
evaṃ gopālakai rājñi vijñapte sampradhārya tat |
ity ukto mantriṇā rājā kṛtvā gopālakān puraḥ |
parīkṣya bhūmiṃ yāvacca khanyate tatra karmibhiḥ |
iti vatseśamuktvā ca tatpūjāṃ pratigṛhya ca |
tataḥ kṛtsnaṃ samādāya nidhānaṃ sa kṛtotsavaḥ |
tān praśāsya ca gopālān vatseśaḥ svapurīṃ yayau ||
vijitya pṛthvīm ārūḍhā yatra me prapitāmahāḥ |
tatrājitvā diśaḥ sarvāḥ kā mamārohataḥ prathā ||
sādhu deva kuru prācyāṃ tarhi pūrvaṃ jayodyamam ||
jāhnavīṃ yāti ca prācīṃ tena prācī praśasyate ||
śrutā kiṃ nātra yuṣmābhiḥ puṃsaḥ sattvavataḥ kathā ||
ādityasyeva yasyeha na caskhāla kila kvacit |
nānyatra dātuṃ śakyā ca devo hi prabhur īdṛśaḥ ||
kāmāgnineva saṃtaptaḥ svinno vigalati sma saḥ ||
tatra tanmukhasaktaikadṛṣṭī rājā hy abhūt tathā |
dadarśa rājakāryāṇi na yathā sumahānty api ||
kālena tasya jajñe ca rājñaḥ sarvābhinanditā |
javasya mama paryāptā kiṃ nu syāditi medinīm |
kiṃcidgatvā ca samprāpya samāṃ bhūmiṃ sa bhūpatiḥ |
tatra daivātsthite tasmin aśve sa sahasā nṛpaḥ |
tanme tvameva śaraṇaṃ śivena naya māṃ pathā ||
tat tathety agrahīd buddhau daivataṃ hi hayottamaḥ ||
tato rājñi samārūḍhe sa pratasthe turaṃgamaḥ |
niśātivāhayogyaṃ ca taṃ sa dṛṣṭvā maṭhaṃ nṛpaḥ |
raṭatsu teṣu tatraiko nirjagāma tato maṭhāt |
yo yuvā bāhuśālī ca tapasārādhya pāvakam |
sa dṛṣṭvā taṃ niśi prāptaṃ dhīro bhavyākṛtiṃ nṛpam |
vidhūya viprāṃś cānyāṃs tān sa sarvānucitāśayaḥ |
rakṣāmyahaṃ śarīraṃ te tatsukhaṃ svapihi prabho |
supte ca tasmin dvārastho jāgarāmāsa sa dvijaḥ |
prātaś ca tasya nṛpateḥ prabuddhasyaiva sa svayam |
rājāpi sa tam āmantrya samāruhya ca vājinam |
akarod ā dināntaṃ ca devī tāvanmahotsavam |
prakhyāpya rātrivṛttāntaṃ dadau tasmai ca tatkṣaṇam |
moghā hi nāma jāyeta mahatsūpakṛtiḥ kutaḥ ||
tasthau ca sevamānastaṃ rājānaṃ sa tadāśritaḥ |
kāle gacchati cānye te sarve prādhānyamicchavaḥ |
saṃgharṣāttair abādhyanta grāmā duṣṭair grahair iva ||
tadekaṃ nāyakaṃ dhīraṃ kurudhvaṃ vacasā mama |
sthirayā yadi kṛtyaṃ vo dhuryarakṣitayā śriyā ||
tacchrutvā nāyakatvaṃ te sarve .py aicchan yadātmanaḥ |
tadā vicintya mūḍhāṃs tān punaś cakradharo .bravīt ||
nāsāsteṣāṃ niśi chittvā yaḥ susattva ihānayet |
sa yuṣmākaṃ pradhānaḥ syādvīro hi svāmyamarhati ||
kurudhvam etat ko doṣa ity uvāca vidūṣakaḥ ||
yo vā śaktaḥ sa kurutāṃ samaye ca vayaṃ sthitāḥ ||
evaṃ kṛte tvamasmākaṃ svāmī niyama eṣa naḥ ||
ity evākhyāpya samayaṃ prāptāyāṃ rajanau ca tān |
āmantrya viprān prayayau śmaśānaṃ sa vidūṣakaḥ ||
praviveśa ca tadvīro nijaṃ karmeva bhīṣaṇam |
dadarśa tatra madhye ca sa tāñ śūlādhiropitān |
yāvac ca nikaṭaṃ teṣāṃ prāpa tāvat trayo .pi te |
niṣkampa eva khaḍgena so .pi pratijaghāna tān |
na śikṣitaḥ prayatno hi dhīrāṇāṃ hṛdaye bhiyā ||
teṣāṃ cakarta baddhvā ca kṛtī jagrāha vāsasi ||
niragāc ca mukhāt tasya jvālā nābheś ca sarṣapāḥ ||
āruroha ca tasyaiva skandhe pravrājako .tha saḥ ||
tuṣṭāsi yadi taddevi dehi me varamīpsitam |
etacchrutvā sa nirgatya kareṇāhatya taṃ punaḥ |
ihaiva tāvat tiṣṭhāmi yāvad āyāty asau śaṭhaḥ |
ityālocya sa tatraiva tasthau channo vidūṣakaḥ ||
āyayau ca gṛhītvā tāṃ gaganena tamomayaḥ |
hā tāta hāmbeti ca tāṃ krandantīṃ kanyakāṃ vahan |
praviveśa ca tatkālaṃ vetālaṃ pravimucya saḥ |
bho vidūṣaka śṛṇvetadyo .yaṃ pravrāṭ tvayā hataḥ |
tato .sya pṛthvīrājye ca vāñchā rājātmajāsu ca |
anugṛhṇanti hi prāyo devatā api tādṛśam ||
tato vastrāñcalāt tasya sa parivrājakasya tān |
jagrāha sarṣapān haste tām aṅke ca nṛpātmajām ||
na me bhaviṣyati prātargatirvyomni tataśca mām |
iti tenoditā bālā bibhyatī sā jagāda tam |
tanmahābhāga mā gāstvaṃ dehi me jīvitaṃ punaḥ |
yad astu me na gacchāmi muñcet prāṇān bhayādiyam ||
tataśca nṛpaterbhaktiḥ kā mayā vihitā bhavet |
suptaṃ prabodhayāmāsa sā prabhāte .pi naiva tam ||
tathaiva gatvā rājñe ca sa samagraṃ nyavedayat ||
papraccha ca yathāvṛttaṃ sa rājā tamupāgatam |
tataḥ saṃbhāvya satyaṃ tat tāṃś cānāyya maṭhadvijān |
svayaṃ śmaśāne gatvā ca dṛṣṭvā tāṃśchinnanāsikān |
dadau tasmai ca tāmeva tadaiva tanayāṃ nijām |
tato rājopacāreṇa sa tayā kāntayā saha |
nātha smarasi yattatra tava devīgṛhe niśi |
tatra cādya gato māso bhavatastacca vismṛtam |
ity uktaḥ priyayā smṛtvā sa jaharṣa vidūṣakaḥ ||
sādhu smṛtaṃ tvayā tanvi vismṛtaṃ tanmayā punaḥ |
prāpto vidūṣako .haṃ bhor iti tatra vadan bahiḥ |
praviśety aśṛṇod vācam antaḥ kenāpy udīritām ||
kimetaditi sāścaryaḥ sa tayā hṛṣṭayā svayam |
ahaṃ vidyādharī kanyā bhadrā nāma mahānvayā |
adya vidyāprayogāś ca saṃmohya preritā mayā |
sā te rājasutaivāsmin kārye smṛtim ajījanat ||
śarīraṃ sundara mayā kuru pāṇigrahaṃ mama ||
sa patirme gataḥ kvāpi rātrāviti ca mātaram |
ityukte rājasutayā rājā tatra svayaṃ yayau ||
vicintyāpi na lebhe taṃ sa kṣitīśo vidūṣakam ||
tato rājñi parāvṛtte nirāśāṃ tāṃ nṛpātmajām |
nāriṣṭaśaṅkā kartavyā sa hi te vartate patiḥ |
pāpaṃ ca te cikīrṣanti tadito gamyatāṃ tvayā |
tadatikramya ca nadī śītodā nāma pāvanī |
priyasya mānuṣasyāsya kṛte cintāṃ ca mā kṛthāḥ ||
ityuktā sā tayā sakhyā bhadrā bhayavaśīkṛtā |
uktvā ca tasya tadyuktyā dattvā ca svāṅgulīyakam |
kṣaṇād apaśyad ātmānaṃ na bhadrāṃ na ca mandiram ||
acintayacca tasyāḥ sa vacaḥ svapnamiva smaran |
na caivaṃ lokadṛṣṭaṃ māṃ labdhvā rājā parityajet ||
tasmādyuktiṃ karomīha kāryaṃ sidhyati me yathā |
niragādatha hā bhadre hā bhadre iti sa bruvan ||
so .yaṃ vidūṣakaḥ prāpta iti kolāhalaṃ vyadhuḥ ||
buddhvā ca rājñā nirgatya svayaṃ dṛṣṭvā tathāvidhaḥ |
tatra tatra sa hā bhadre iti pratyuttaraṃ dadau ||
tyajet kadācana prāṇān brahmahatyā bhavet tataḥ ||
ityālocya sa cādityaseno rājā mumoca tam ||
vīro bhadrāṃ prati svairaṃ sa pratasthe vidūṣakaḥ ||
gacchann ahar ahaḥ prācyāṃ diśi prāpa sa ca kramāt |
tubhyameva mayā dattaṃ putra sarvamidaṃ gṛham |
tadgṛhāṇa yato nāsti jīvitaṃ mama sāṃpratam ||
mayā duḥkhena labdheyam iti tāṃ duḥkhalabdhikām |
praviṣṭa eva prathamaṃ tatkālaṃ pañcatāṃ yayau ||
tato vimanasā rājñā bhūyo .pyetena sā sutā |
tadbhayācca yadānye .pi nṛpā vāñchanti naiva tām |
ito deśāt tvayaikaikaḥ kramād ekaikato gṛhāt |
iti senāpatī rājñā samāviṣṭo dine dine |
evaṃ ca tatra yātāni kṣayaṃ naraśatānyapi |
dadāmi sarvaṃ yena syāṃ na punarduḥkhabhāginī ||

column21: evaṃ vidūṣakeṇoktā brāhmaṇī sā jagāda tam ||

column3: yadyevamamba tarhi tvaṃ mā sma viklavatāṃ kṛthāḥ ||
kimetaṃ ghātayāmīti kṛpā te mayi mā ca bhūt ||
siddhiyogāddhi nāstyeva bhayaṃ tatra gatasya me |
evaṃ vidūṣakeṇoktā brāhmaṇī sā jagāda tam ||
tatprāṇāndehi naḥ putra kuśalaṃ ca tathātmani ||
paśyāmi tāvat ko hanti narānatreti cintayan ||
sa ca dvāri sthitastatra rākṣaso vāsakāntare |
vidūṣakaśca cicheda dhāvitvā tasya taṃ krudhā |
bhītā ca jātaharṣā ca vismitā ca babhūva sā ||
prātaśca dadṛśe rājñā devasenena tatra saḥ |
tato divyaprabhāvāya tasmai prītaḥ sa pārthivaḥ |
tatastayā samaṃ tatra kāntayā sa vidūṣakaḥ |
ekasmiṃśca dine suptāṃ rājaputrīṃ vihāya tām |
sa tataḥ prayayau rātrau tāṃ bhadrāṃ prati satvaraḥ ||
tatra cakre sa kenāpi vaṇijā saha saṃgatim |
tasmai nijadhanārdhaṃ ca svasutāṃ ca dadāmyaham ||

column5: ahaṃ tvayi mama tvaṃ ca mayi te teṣu cāpyaham |

column3: dhyātopasthitamāgneyaṃ khaḍgaṃ kṛtvā ca taṃ kare |
jaṅghāyāṃ tasya ruddhaṃ ca yānapātraṃ vyalokayat ||
cicheda tāṃ sa jaṅghāṃ ca tasya khaḍgena tatkṣaṇam |
cacāla ca pravahaṇaṃ rodhamuktaṃ tadaiva tat ||
vṛttenaiva ca muktena drutaṃ pravahaṇena saḥ |
iti saṃcintya tatkālaṃ jaṅghāṃ tāmāruroha saḥ |
anena tava dhairyeṇa tuṣṭo .smi tadidaṃ śṛṇu ||
madvarācca tavedānīṃ kṣuttṛṣṇā ca na vartsyati |
pratasthe saptame cāhni prāpa kārkoṭakaṃ puram ||
sāyaṃ ca tanmaṭhasthaḥ san pure śuśrāva tatra saḥ |

column5: ghoṣyamāṇaṃ sapaṭahaṃ pure tasminn idaṃ vacaḥ ||

column3: prātaricchati yaḥ so .dya rātrau vasatu tadgṛhe ||
tacchrutvā sanimittaṃ sa tadāśaṅkya ca tatkṣaṇam |
yo hi tatra praviśati kṣapāyāṃ na sa jīvati |
dṛṣṭvā vyacintayac cāsau hanta so .yaṃ niśācaraḥ |
yasya bāhur mayā chinno nagare pauṇḍravardhane ||
tadadya na punarbāhau prahariṣyāmyasau hi me |
mā māṃ vadhīḥ susattvastvaṃ tatkuruṣva kṛpāmiti ||
kiṃnāmā tvaṃ ca keyaṃ ca tava ceṣṭeti tena saḥ |
muktvā pṛṣṭaśca vīreṇa punarāha sa rākṣasaḥ ||
tatrādau bāhur ekena chinno me pauṇḍravardhane |
tvayā cādya jito .smīha tat samāptam idaṃ mama ||
mayaiva sa bhujas tatra lūnaste pauṇḍravardhane ||
tadidānīṃ suhṛnme tvaṃ yadā māṃ ca smariṣyasi |
evaṃ sa rākṣaso maitryā varayitvā vidūṣakam |
ekadā ca niśi svairaṃ tataḥ prāyātpriyotsukaḥ |
nagarācca vinirgatya sa taṃ sasmāra rākṣasam |
yayau ca sa tayā rātryā durgamāṃ ṣaṣṭiyojanīm ||
ity uktvā rākṣase tasmin prāptānujñe tirohite |
dīrghikāṃ sa dadarśaikāṃ ramyāṃ tatra vidūṣakaḥ ||
idaṃ snānodakaṃ tasyā iti tāśca tamabruvan ||
yadekā sahasaiva strī tāsāṃ madhyāduvāca tam |
tatheti ca ghaṭe tasyāḥ skandhotkṣipte sa buddhimān |
taddṛṣṭvā pratyabhijñāya bhadrā papraccha tāḥ sakhīḥ |
ihānayata gatvā taṃ sa hi bhartā mamāgataḥ ||
ityukte bhadrayā gatvā yathāvastu nivedya ca |
prāptaśca sa dadarśātra bhadrāṃ mārgonmukhīṃ cirāt |
āryaputra na me kāryaṃ sakhibhirna ca siddhibhiḥ |
tvaṃ me prāṇā guṇakrītā dāsī cāhaṃ tava prabho ||
tatheti pratipede sā bhadrā sapadi tadvacaḥ |
tatastayā samaṃ tatra sa viśaśrāma tāṃ niśām |
sasmāra yamadaṃṣṭraṃ taṃ rākṣasaṃ sa punaḥ kṛtī ||
tasyāruroha sa skandhe bhadrāmāropya tāṃ puraḥ ||
vidūṣakaḥ punaḥ prāpa tacca kārkoṭakaṃ puram ||
dṛṣṭvāryavarmanṛpatiṃ svāṃ bhāryāṃ mārgati sma saḥ ||
dattāṃ tena gṛhītvā ca tatsutāṃ tāṃ bhujārjitām |
gatvāmbudhestaṭe prāpa pāpaṃ taṃ vaṇijaṃ ca saḥ |
yenāsya vāridhau pūrvaṃ chinnāḥ kṣiptasya rajjavaḥ ||
jahāra tasya ca sutāṃ vaṇijaḥ sa dhanaiḥ saha |
prāpa tacca sa bhūyo .pi nagaraṃ pauṇḍravardhanam |
acireṇa ca tāṃ prāpa purīṃ rākṣasayogataḥ |
gate ca rākṣase tasmin sa tena saha bhūbhujā |
tatra tāṃ prathamāṃ bhāryāṃ tanayāṃ tasya bhūpateḥ |
iti pṛṣṭaḥ sa rājñātra sarvamasmai śaśaṃsa tat ||
ityāptarājyavibhavaḥ kramaśaḥ sa kṛtsnāṃ jitvā mahīmakhilarājakapūjitāṅghriḥ |
ityanukūle daive bhajati nijaṃ sattvam eva dhīrāṇām |
itthaṃ śrutvā vatsarājasya vaktrāccitrām etām adbhutārthāṃ kathāṃ te |
pārśvāsīnā mantriṇaś cāsya sarve devyau cāpi prītimagryāmavāpuḥ ||
rājan daivānukūlyaṃ ca vidyate pauruṣaṃ ca te ||
nītimārge ca vayam apy atra kiṃcitkṛtaśramāḥ |
tad yathācintitaṃ śīghraṃ kuruṣva vijayaṃ diśām ||
astv etad bahuvighnās tu sadā kalyāṇasiddhayaḥ ||
atas tadarthaṃ tapasā śaṃbhum ārādhayāmy aham |
tatas taṃ saha devībhyāṃ sacivaiś ca tapaḥsthitam |
tuṣṭo .smi te tad uttiṣṭha nirvighnaṃ jayam āpsyasi |
ānandayacca sacivān prātaḥ svapnena tena saḥ |
lebhe sa rājā tapasā prabhāvaṃ pūrvajaiḥ samam |
puṇyāṃ pativratānāṃ ca tatpatnyau kīrtim āpatuḥ ||
dhanyas tvaṃ yasya caivetthaṃ prasanno bhagavān haraḥ |
tad idānīṃ ripūñjitvā bhaja lakṣmīṃ bhujārjitām ||
sā hi svadharmasambhūtā bhūbhṛtām anvaye sthirā |
praṇaṣṭo bhavatā prāptaḥ kiṃcātraitāṃ kathāṃ śṛṇu ||
abhavat tasya bhāryā ca nagarāt pauṇḍravardhanāt |
sa devadāso dyūtena sarvaṃ dhanam ahārayat ||
tataś ca tasya sā bhāryā duḥkhadāridryaduḥkhitā |
etya nītā nijaṃ gehaṃ svapitrā pauṇḍravardhanam ||
śanaiḥ so .pi vipatkhinnaḥ sthātum icchan svakarmaṇi |
mūlyārthī devadāsas taṃ śvaśuraṃ yācituṃ yayau ||
prāptaś ca saṃdhyāsamaye tat puraṃ pauṇḍravardhanam |
varaṃ hi mānino mṛtyur na dainyaṃ svajanāgrataḥ ||
ity ālocyāpaṇe gatvā sa kvāpi vipaṇer bahiḥ |
drutam antaḥ praviṣṭāṃ ca striyam ekāṃ dadarśa saḥ ||
dhanahīnena deho .pi hāryate strīṣu kā kathā |
tad iyaṃ sā vipat puṃsāṃ vyasanārṇavapātinām |
iti saṃcintayaṃstasyā bhāryāyāḥ sa bahiḥ sthitaḥ |
upetya ca dadau dvāri sa karṇaṃ sāpi tatkṣaṇam |
ity abravīd upapatiṃ pāpā taṃ vaṇijaṃ rahaḥ ||
śṛṇv idaṃ kathayāmy adya rahasyaṃ te .nurāgiṇī |
kumbhāś caturṣu koṇeṣu nigūḍhāḥ sthāpitā bhuvi ||
tad ekasyāḥ svabhāryāyāḥ sa cakre viditaṃ tadā |
tadbhāryā cāntakāle sā snuṣāyai tad avocata ||
sāpi snuṣāyai macchvaśrve macchvaśrūr abravīc ca me |
svabhartus tacca na mayā daridrasyāpi varṇitam |
sa hi dyūtarato dveṣyas tvaṃ tu me paramaḥ priyaḥ ||
tat tatra gatvā madbhartuḥ sakāśāt tadgṛhaṃ dhanaiḥ |
krītvā tat prāpya ca svarṇam ihaitya bhaja māṃ sukham ||
evam uktaḥ kuṭilayā sa tayopapatir vaṇik |
tutoṣa tasyai manvāno nidhiṃ labdham ayatnataḥ ||
kīlitām iva tatkālaṃ dhanāśāṃ hṛdaye dadhau ||
jagāma ca tataḥ sadyaḥ puraṃ pāṭaliputrakam |
prāpya ca svagṛhaṃ labdhvā nidhānaṃ svīcakāra tat ||
devadāsasakāśāc ca krīṇāti sma sa tadgṛham |
devadāso .pi mūlyena bhūyasā tasya tad dadau ||
sa devadāsaḥ śīghraṃ tām ānināya svagehinīm ||
evaṃ kṛte ca tadbhāryākāmukaḥ sa vaṇik śaṭhaḥ |
etad bhavadgṛhaṃ jīrṇaṃ mahyaṃ na khalu rocate |
tad dehi me nijaṃ mūlyaṃ svagṛhaṃ svīkuruṣva ca ||
iti jalpaṃśca sa vaṇig devadāsaś ca vibruvan |
devadāso narendrāgre kṛtsnam udgirati sma tam ||
tataś cānāyya tadbhāryāṃ tattvaṃ cānviṣya bhūpatiḥ |
anyāṃ ca pariṇīyātra tasthau labdhanidhiḥ sukham ||
ato yateta dharmeṇa dhanam arjayituṃ pumān |
rājā tu sutarāṃ yena mūlaṃ rājyataror dhanam ||
kuru digvijayaṃ deva labdhuṃ dharmottarāṃ śriyam ||
vikurvate na bahavo rājānas te milanti ca ||
nityaṃ vairī sa te tasmād vijayasva tam agrataḥ ||
uccaiḥ kuruṣva vai pāṇḍor yaśaś ca kumudojjvalam ||
dadau vaidehadeśe ca rājyaṃ gopālakāya saḥ |
ākulatvaṃ tu śatrūṇāṃ hṛdi citram ajāyata ||
brahmadattaṃ prati prācyāṃ pūrvaṃ vatseśvaro yayau ||
naivaiṣa rājā sahate pareṣāṃ prasṛtaṃ mahaḥ |
padāt padaṃ ca dve devyau mārge tam anujagmatuḥ |
namatātha palāyadhvam ity ūce vidviṣām iva |
evaṃ yayau sa digbhāgān paśyan phullasitāmbujān |
ācāryo .yaṃ trikālajña iti vyājaguruṃ ca tam |
śiṣyās te khyāpayāmāsur bhikṣāśinam itas tataḥ ||
yad uvācāgnidāhādi sa jñānī bhāvi pṛcchatām |
tacchiṣyās tat tathā guptaṃ cakrus tena sa paprathe ||
vṛkṣān kusumavallīśca toyāni ca tṛṇāni ca ||
tacca vijñāya sa jñānaliṅgī cāro nyavedayat |
vatseśvaraṃ brahmadatto mene durjayam eva tam ||
tataḥ sa nikaṭībhūtaṃ vatseśaṃ svayam abhyagāt ||
itthaṃ tasmiñjite prācīṃ śamayan namayan mṛdūn |
unmūlayaṃśca kaṭhinān nṛpān vāyur iva drumān ||
tasya velātaṭānte ca jayastambhaṃ cakāra saḥ |
avanamya kare datte kaliṅgair agragais tataḥ |
gajair jitvāṭavīṃ rājñāṃ sa yayau dakṣiṇāṃ diśam ||
na paraṃ muralānāṃ sa sehe mūrdhasu nonnatim |
yat tasya saptadhā bhinnaṃ papur godāvarīpayaḥ |
athottīrya sa vatseśo revām ujjayinīm agāt |
tasthau ca nirvṛtas tatra tathā śvaśurasatkṛtaḥ |
viśramya ca niśāḥ kāścit prīto vatseśvaras tataḥ |
anvitaḥ śvāśuraiḥ sainyaiḥ prayayau paścimāṃ diśam ||
asau mathitum ambhodhiṃ mā mām unmūlayiṣyati |
pratīcyām udayaṃ prāpa prakṛṣṭam api yajjayī ||
kṣapayāmāsa ca mlecchān rāghavo rākṣasān iva ||
rāhor iva sa cicheda pārasīkapateḥ śiraḥ ||
naman vicchāyatāṃ bheje yat tadā na tad adbhutam ||
taddattair anvito nāgaiḥ samrāḍ vivavṛte .tha saḥ |
tato magadhabhūbhṛtā sanagareṇa tenārcitaḥ samagrajanamānasair anugato .nurāgāgataiḥ |
nigīrṇavasudhātalo balabhareṇa lāvāṇakaṃ jagāma viṣayaṃ nijaṃ sa kila vatsarājo jayī ||
tataḥ sa senāviśrāntyai tatra lāvāṇake sthitaḥ |
tvadbuddhyā nirjitāḥ sarve pṛthivyāṃ bhūbhṛto mayā |
upāyasvīkṛtās te ca naiva vyabhicaranti me ||
jāne vyabhicaraty eko viśvāsaḥ kuṭileṣu kaḥ ||
na rājan brahmadattas te bhūyo vyabhicariṣyati ||
śubhācārasya kaḥ kuryād aśubhaṃ hi sacetanaḥ ||
kurvīta vā yas tasyaiva tadātmany aśubhaṃ bhavet |
tathā ca śrūyatām atra kathāṃ te varṇayāmy aham ||
ādyas tayor abhūn mūrkhaḥ svākṛtir durvinītakaḥ |
kṛtadārāvubhau tau ca pitary astaṃ gate tataḥ |
ekadā baddhagoṣṭhīkaṃ śūdraiḥ saha vilokya tam |
nijam evānujaṃ dṛṣṭvā rājapūjyaṃ na lajjase ||
tacchrutvā kupitaḥ so .tha somadattaḥ pradhāvya tam |
tatra vipraḥ sa kṛtvānyān sākṣiṇas tatkṣaṇaṃ dvijān |
te ca nirgatya tanmittrair jaghnire śastrapāṇibhiḥ ||
āropyamāṇaḥ śūlāyām athākasmāt sa ca dvijaḥ |
prakṣipta iva kenāpi nipapāta tataḥ kṣitau ||
yadā ca naicchan gamanaṃ sametās tasya bāndhavāḥ |
tato vṛttyantarābhāvāt kartuṃ sa cakame kṛṣim |
tadyogyāṃ ca bhuvaṃ draṣṭuṃ śubhe .hany aṭavīṃ yayau ||
tatra lebhe śubhāṃ bhūmiṃ saṃbhāvya phalasaṃpadam |
prāvṛṭkālam ivālokya kṛṣyarthī toṣam āpa saḥ ||
kṛtvā baliṃ tasya taror ārebhe kṛṣim atra saḥ ||
tasthau tasyaiva cādhastād drumasya sa divāniśam |
bhojanaṃ tasya cāninye tatraiva gṛhiṇī sadā ||
kāle tatra ca pakveṣu tasya sasyeṣvaśaṅkitam |
sā bhūmiḥ pararāṣṭreṇa daivād etya vyaluṇṭhyata ||
tataḥ parabale yāte naṣṭe sasye sa sattvavān |
prāgvat kṛtabalis tasthau tatraivātha taror adhaḥ |
nisargaḥ sa hi dhīrāṇāṃ yad āpadyadhikaṃ dṛḍhāḥ ||
bhoḥ somadatta tuṣṭo .smi tava tad gaccha bhūpateḥ |
phalabhūtir ahaṃ nāmnā vipraḥ śṛṇuta vacmi yat |
bhadrakṛt prāpnuyād bhadram abhadraṃ cāpy abhadrakṛt ||
column9: so .vādīd bhadrakṛd bhadram abhadraṃ cāpy abhadrakṛt |

column3: evaṃ vadaṃśca tatra tvaṃ mahatīm ṛddhim āpsyasi |
ahaṃ ca yakṣa ityuktvā svaprabhāveṇa tatkṣaṇam |
tam adhyāpya ca tān mantrān vaṭe vāṇī tirodadhe ||
prātaḥ sa somadattaś ca pratasthe bhāryayā saha |
phalabhūtir iti prāpya nāma yakṣakṛtaṃ kṛtī ||
durdaśā iva samprāpa śrīkaṇṭhaviṣayaṃ ca saḥ ||
yathāvan nāma saṃśrāvya phalabhūtir iti svakam ||
so .vādīd bhadrakṛd bhadram abhadraṃ cāpy abhadrakṛt |
column5: bhadrakṛt prāpnuyād bhadram abhadraṃ cāpy abhadrakṛt ||

column3: muhuś ca tadvadantaṃ taṃ tatrādityaprabho nṛpaḥ |
so .pi praviśya tasyāgre tad eva muhur abravīt |
jahāsa tena sa nṛpas tadā pārśvasthitaiḥ saha ||
sasāmantaś ca vastrāṇi dattvā cābharaṇāni saḥ |
grāmān rājā dadau tasmai na toṣo mahatāṃ mṛṣā ||
evaṃ ca tatkṣaṇaṃ prāpa guhyakānugraheṇa saḥ |
sadā tad eva ca vadan pūrvoktaṃ prāpa bhūpateḥ |
rājapriya iti prītiṃ bahumānām avāpa saḥ ||
tena pṛṣṭā kṣaṇād evam avocad yācitābhayā ||
atra cāgamavṛttāntaṃ siddhiṃ ca śṛṇu me prabho ||
tam upāgatya bhaktyā tvaṃ pūjaya prārthitapradam |
yena nirvighnam evāśu svocitaṃ patim āpsyasi ||
tacchrutvā paryapṛcchyanta sakhyas tā maugdhyato mayā |
atha tāḥ pratyavocan māṃ kim etāvat tvayocyate |
tasminn apūjite nāsti siddhiḥ kāpīha kasyacit ||
tathā caitatprabhāvaṃ te varṇayāmo vayaṃ śṛṇu |
ityuktvā ca vayasyā me kathām akathayann imām ||
purā purāres tanayaṃ senānyaṃ prāptum icchati |
gaurī kṛtatapāḥ prārthya prāpya ca tryambakaṃ patim ||
na ca sasmāra siddhyarthaṃ sā vighneśvarapūjanam ||
priye prajāpateḥ pūrvaṃ mānasād ajani smaraḥ ||
atidṛpto .si cet putra tat trinetrasya laṅghanam |
ekasya rakṣer mā nāma mṛtyuṃ tasmād avāpsyasi ||
mayā dagdho na tasyāsti sadehasyodbhavaḥ punaḥ ||
bhavatyās tu svaśaktyaiva putram utpādayāmy aham |
na hi me madanotsāhahetukā lokavat prajā ||
aṅgīcakre śivaḥ sraṣṭuṃ devyām ātmajam aurasam ||
anumene ca kāmasya janma cetasi dehinām |
tena tuṣṭo yayau dhātā mudaṃ prāpa ca pārvatī ||
tato yāteṣu divaseṣv ekadā rahasi sthitaḥ |
so .py agniḥ smṛtamātraḥ sann adhṛṣyaṃ madanāntakam |
bhekān kṛtvā tirobhūya bhūyo .gnir mandaraṃ yayau ||
prāpur gajaśukākhyātaṃ sa caiṣāṃ darśanaṃ dadau ||
pratipede ca devānāṃ sa kāryaṃ taiḥ kṛtastutiḥ ||
gatvā ca svoṣmaṇā so .gnir nivārya suratācchivam |
śarvo .py ārūḍhavego .gnau tasmin vīryaṃ svam ādadhe |
taddhi dhārayituṃ śakto na vahnir nāmbikāpi vā ||
na mayā tanayas tvattaḥ samprāpta iti vādinīm |
tad arcayainaṃ yenāśu vahnau no janitā sutaḥ ||
tat tejaḥ śāṃbhavaṃ bibhrat sa tadā divaseṣv api |
udvavāma ca gaṅgāyāṃ tat tejaḥ so .tha durdharam |
tatra saṃrakṣyamāṇaḥ san sa garbhaḥ śāṃbhavairgaṇaiḥ |
ṣaṇṇāṃ ṣaḍbhir mukhaiḥ pītvā svalpaiḥ sa vavṛdhe dinaiḥ ||
devāś ca sākam ṛṣibhiḥ ṣaṇmukhaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ |
ṣaṇmukho .pi surān rakṣann āsīt taiḥ parivāritaḥ ||
tad buddhvā hāritaṃ matvā rājyam indro .tha cukṣubhe |
yodhayāmāsa gatvā ca kumāraṃ sa samatsaraḥ ||
upetya tanayaṃ śarvaḥ svayaṃ yuddhād avārayat ||
jāto .si tārakaṃ hantuṃ rājyaṃ cendrasya rakṣitum |
tat kuruṣva nijaṃ kāryam iti cainaṃ śaśāsa saḥ ||
tataḥ śakraḥ śucam agād athainam avadacchivaḥ ||
na pūjito gajamukhaḥ senānyaṃ vāñchatā tvayā |
tenaiṣa vighno jātas te tat kuruṣva tadarcanam ||
tacchrutvā tat tathā kṛtvā muktabāhuḥ śacīpatiḥ |
nananduḥ siddhakāryāś ca devā gaurī ca putriṇī ||
tad evaṃ devi devānām api santi na siddhayaḥ |
tad dṛṣṭvā kautukād vyomnaḥ samāhūyāvatārya ca |
mayā siddhisvarūpaṃ tāḥ pṛṣṭāḥ sadyo .bruvann idam ||
kālarātrir iti khyātā brāhmaṇī gurur atra naḥ ||
atha tatsiddhilubdhatvād avocaṃ tāḥ sakhīr aham |
tato madabhyarthanayā gatvā tatkṣaṇam eva tāḥ |
abhiṣicya ca sā mahyaṃ tāṃstān mantrān nijān dadau |
bhakṣitās tatra cāsmābhiḥ sametya bahavo narāḥ ||
asmin kathāntare caitāṃ mahārāja kathāṃ śṛṇu |
sa ca tasminn upādhyāyo deśe nānādigāgatān |
śiṣyamadhye ca tasyaiko nāmnā sundarako yuvā |
vavre rahasi kāmārtā patyau kvāpi bahir gate ||
nūnaṃ virūpair adhikaṃ hāsanaiḥ krīḍati smaraḥ |
yat sānavekṣya svaṃ rūpaṃ cakre sundarakaspṛhām ||
sa tu sarvātmanā naicchad arthyamāno .pi viplavam |
striyo yathā viceṣṭantāṃ niṣkampaṃ tu satāṃ manaḥ ||
tataḥ sāpasṛte tasmin kālarātriḥ krudhā tadā |
gṛhaṃ yāvad upādhyāyo viṣṇusvāmī viveśa saḥ ||
praviṣṭaṃ tam avādīcca paśya sundarakeṇa me |
tacchrutvā sa upādhyāyaḥ krudhā jajvāla tatkṣaṇam |
pratyayaḥ strīṣu muṣṇāti vimarśaṃ viduṣām api ||
sāyaṃ ca taṃ sundarakaṃ gṛhaprāptaṃ pradhāvya saḥ |
kiṃca prahāraniśceṣṭaṃ śiṣyān ādiśya taṃ bahiḥ |
yenāvicārya vṛddho .pi vidvān api ca tat tathā |
tathā hi kiṃ na munayaḥ svadārabhraṃśaśaṅkinaḥ |
buddhvā taṃ devam īśānaṃ tam eva śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ||
iti sundarakas tatra dhyāyan dasyubhayān niśi |
tāvat tatraiva harmye sā kālarātrir upāyayau ||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛśīṃ tatra kālarātrim upāgatām |
sasmāra mantrān rakṣoghnān bhītaḥ sundarako .tha saḥ ||
tanmantramohitā cātha taṃ dadarśa na sā tadā |
taṃ ca mantraṃ sa jagrāha śrutvā sundarakas tadā |
saharmyā sāpi nabhasā kṣipram ujjayinīṃ yayau ||
ākāśena saśiṣyā sā niśi svagṛham āyayau ||
visṛjyānucarīs tāś ca śayyāveśma viveśa sā ||
so .pi sundarako nītvā tāṃ niśāṃ vighnavismitaḥ |
taiḥ samāśvāsito mittrais tanmadhye sthitim agrahīt ||
uvāsa tatra viharan svacchandaḥ sakhibhiḥ saha ||
upetya ca jagādainaṃ punar eva smarāturā |
evam uktas tayā so .tha sādhuḥ sundarako .bravīt |
maivaṃ vadīr na dharmo .yaṃ mātā me gurupatny asi ||
tato .bravīt kālarātrir dharmaṃ ced vetsi dehi tat |
prāṇān me prāṇadānāddhi dharmaḥ ko .bhyadhiko bhavet ||
atha sundarako .vādīn mātar maivaṃ kṛthā hṛdi |
evaṃ nirākṛtā tena tarjayantī ca taṃ ruṣā |
sa ca tasyāḥ patiḥ krodhād gatvā vadhyam udīrya ca |
tataḥ sundarakaḥ khedāt taṃ deśaṃ tyaktum udyataḥ |
tad eva śūnyagovāṭaharmyaṃ niśi punar yayau ||
tatra tasmin sthite prāgvat kālarātrir upetya sā |
taṃ ca sundarako mantraṃ bhūyaḥ śrutvāpi nāgrahīt |
vinā hi gurvādeśena sampūrṇāḥ siddhayaḥ kutaḥ ||
netuṃ prakṣipya govāṭe tatra tasthau sa pūrvavat ||
so .pi sundarakaḥ prātar govāṭān nirgatas tataḥ |
mālavīyā vinā mūlyaṃ jahrur dṛṣṭvā svadeśajam ||
tataḥ sa kalahaṃ kurvan baddhvā suhṛdanudrutaḥ |
hanti pratyuta pāṣāṇair ityuktas taiḥ śaṭhair nṛpaḥ |
taṃ tad adbhutam aprākṣīt tatas tatsuhṛdo .bruvan ||
tadaitat kautukaṃ deva kṛtsnaṃ jalpati nānyathā ||
utpapāta sa mantreṇa sadyaḥ sundarako nabhaḥ ||
samitras tena gatvā ca prayāgaṃ prāpya ca kramāt |
śrāntaḥ kamapi rājānaṃ snātaṃ tatra dadarśa saḥ ||
saṃstabhya cātra prāsādaṃ gaṅgāyāṃ khān nipatya ca |
vismayodvīkṣitaḥ sarvais taṃ sa rājānam abhyagāt ||
kas tvaṃ kiṃ cāvatīrṇo .si gaganād iti śaṃsa naḥ |
rājñā prahveṇa pṛṣṭaḥ sann evaṃ sundarako .bravīt ||
ahaṃ murajako nāma gaṇo devasya dhūrjaṭeḥ |
sastrīkaṃ sopakaraṇaṃ dadau tasmai puraṃ nṛpaḥ ||
praviśyātha pure tasminn utpatya divi sānugaḥ |
ciraṃ sundarakaḥ svecchaṃ nirdainyaṃ vicacāra saḥ ||
sevyamāno varastrībhir aindraṃ sukham avāpa saḥ ||
buddhvā tatra svayaṃ rājā kautukāt tam upāyayau ||
parijñātaś ca pṛṣṭaś ca rājāgre so .tha kālavit |
kupite ca nṛpe tasyāḥ karṇau ca chettum udyate |
sā gṛhītāpi paśyatsu sarveṣv eva tirodadhe ||
tataḥ svarāṣṭre vāso .syās tatra rājñā nyaṣidhyata |
tatpūjitaḥ sundarakaḥ śiśriye ca nabhaḥ punaḥ ||
etacca matpitur deśe vṛttaṃ sarvatra viśrutam ||
kālarātreś ca śiṣyāham ityādau varṇitaṃ mayā |
pativratātvāt siddhis tu tato .py abhyadhikā mama ||
bhavatā cādya dṛṣṭāhaṃ śreyo.rthaṃ te kṛtārcanā |
tad asmadīye .tra naye tvam api praviśādhunā |
siddhiyogajitānāṃ ca rājñāṃ mūrdhni padaṃ kuru ||
kva ca rājatvam ityuktvā sa rājā niṣiṣedha tat ||
tataḥ sā taṃ praveśyaiva maṇḍale pūrvapūjite |
ya eṣa phalabhūtyākhyaḥ sthito vipras tavāntike |
ākarṣaṇaṃ ca sāyāsaṃ tat kaścit sūpakṛd varam |
naye .tra sthāpyatāṃ yas taṃ svayaṃ hanti pacaty api ||
na kāryā ca ghṛṇā yasmāt tanmāsabalibhakṣaṇāt |
samāpite .rcane pūrṇā siddhiḥ syād uttamo hi saḥ ||
ityuktaḥ priyayā rājā pāpabhīto .pi tat punaḥ |
viśvāsya dīkṣitaṃ kṛtvā daṃpatī tau sahocatuḥ ||
rājā devīdvitīyo .dya bhokṣyate tat tvarāṃ kuru |
āhārasyeti yo .bhyetya tvāṃ brūyāt taṃ nipātayeḥ ||
tanmāṃsaiś ca rahaḥ kuryāḥ prātar nau svādu bhojanam |
iti sūpakṛd ādiṣṭas tathetyuktvā gṛhaṃ yayau ||
prātaś ca phalabhūtiṃ taṃ prāptaṃ rājā jagāda saḥ |
atas tvaritam āhāram uttamaṃ sādhayer iti ||
tatheti nirgataṃ taṃ ca phalabhūtiṃ bahis tadā |
etya candraprabho nāma rājñaḥ putro .bravīd idam ||
anena śīghraṃ hemnā me kārayādyaiva kuṇḍale |
tanmāṃsaiḥ sādhitaṃ tena bhojanaṃ ca kṛtārcanau |
abhuñjātām ajānantau tattvaṃ rājñī nṛpas tathā ||
nītvā ca sānutāpas tāṃ rātriṃ rājā dadarśa saḥ |
vibhrāntaḥ kuṇḍaloddeśāt taṃ ca papraccha tatkṣaṇam |
hā putreti ca cakranda nindan bhāryāṃ sahātmanā |
pṛṣṭaś ca sacivaiḥ sarvaṃ yathātattvam avarṇayat ||
uvāca caitad uktaṃ tat pratyahaṃ phalabhūtinā |

column5: bhadrakṛt prāpnuyād bhadram abhadraṃ cāpy abhadrakṛt ||
column9: so .vādīd bhadrakṛd bhadram abhadraṃ cāpy abhadrakṛt |

column3: ityuktvā bodhayitvā ca mantriṇaḥ svān adhomukhān |
tam eva phalabhūtiṃ ca nije rājye .bhiṣicya saḥ ||
phalabhūtiś ca tad rājyaṃ prāpya pṛthvīṃ śaśāsa saḥ |
evaṃ bhadram abhadraṃ vā kṛtam ātmani kalpyate ||
tasmāt tava sa rājendra jitvāpyācarataḥ śubham |
brahmadatto vikurvīta yadi hanyās tvam eva tam ||
nṛpaiḥ praṇamyamānaś ca rājā mandiram āyayau ||
pūrvaṃ nidhānādhigataṃ kulocitaṃ prasahya siṃhāsanam āruroha tat ||
vividham atha vitīrya vītalobho vasu vasudhāvijayārjitaṃ dvijebhyaḥ |
akṛta kṛtamahotsavaḥ kṛtārthaṃ kṣitipatimaṇḍalam ātmamantriṇaś ca ||
kṣetreṣu varṣati tadānuguṇaṃ narendre tasmin dhvanadghanamṛdaṅganināditāyām |
saṃbhāvya bhāvi bahudhānyaphalaṃ jano .pi tasyāṃ puri pratigṛhaṃ vihitotsavo .bhūt ||
tasthau yatheccham atha vāsavadattayātra padmāvatīsahitayā saha vatsarājaḥ ||
kīrtiśriyor iva tayor ubhayoś ca devyor madhyasthitaḥ sa varacāraṇagīyamānaḥ |
candrodayaṃ nijayaśodhavalaṃ siṣeve śatrupratāpam iva sīdhu papau ca śaśvat ||
tato vatseśvaro rājā sa kauśāmbyām avasthitaḥ |
svayaṃ sa vādayan vīṇāṃ devyā vāsavadattayā |
harmyāgre nijakīrtyeva jyotsnayā dhavale ca saḥ |
dhārāvigalitaṃ sīdhu papau madam iva dviṣām ||
upaninye dvayor madhye sa svacittam ivāsavam ||
na mukhe tat tayo rājñyos taddṛṣṭis tṛptim āyayau ||
śvānaḥ śvabhre vane tasmiṃstasya vartmasu vāgurāḥ |
sa tena racitātithyo muhuḥ prahveṇa bhūbhṛtā |
prītaḥ kṣaṇam iva sthitvā rājānaṃ tam abhāṣata ||
śṛṇu saṃkṣiptam etat te vatseśvara vadāmy aham |
babhūva pāṇḍur iti te rājā pūrvapitāmahaḥ ||
taveva tasya dve eva bhavye bhārye babhūvatuḥ |
ekā kuntī dvitīyā ca mādrī nāma mahaujasaḥ ||
sa pāṇḍuḥ pṛthivīm etāṃ jitvā jaladhimekhalām |
sa munir mṛgarūpaṃ tat tyaktvā kaṇṭhavivartibhiḥ |
prāṇaiḥ śaśāpa taṃ pāṇḍuṃ viṣaṇṇaṃ muktakārmukam ||
svairastho nirvimarśena hato .haṃ yat tvayā tataḥ |
patnībhyām anvitaḥ pāṇḍus tasthau śānte tapovane ||
tatrastho .pi sa śāpena preritas tena caikadā |
akasmāccakame mādrīṃ priyāṃ prāpa ca pañcatām ||
tad evaṃ mṛgayā nāma pramādo nṛpa bhūbhṛtām |
kṣapitā hyanayānye .pi nṛpās te te mṛgā iva ||
kuntadantā kathaṃ kuryād rākṣasīva hi sā śivam ||
tvaṃ ca tvatpūrvajaprītyā priyaḥ kalyāṇapātra me |
putraś ca tava kāmāṃśo yathā bhāvī tathā śṛṇu ||
tuṣṭo rahasi saṃkṣepam idaṃ tasyāḥ śivo .bhyadhāt ||
jātā vāsavadatteyaṃ sampannā mahiṣī ca te ||
tad eṣā śaṃbhum ārādhya kāmāṃśaṃ soṣyate sutam |
pratyarpya tasmai sa yayau nāradarṣir adarśanam ||
tasmin gate vatsarājaḥ sa tad vāsavadattayā |
brāhmaṇī kulajā cāham īdṛśīṃ durgatiṃ gatā ||
daivād yugapad etau ca jātau dvau tanayau mama |
tad deva nāsti me stanyam etayor bhojanaṃ vinā ||
prāptāsmi devaṃ śaraṇaṃ pramāṇam adhunā prabhuḥ ||
tacchrutvā sadayo rājā sa pratīhāram ādiśat |
rājñā visṛṣṭāṃ buddhvā tāṃ pratīhārād upāgatām |
yugmāpatyāṃ ca paśyantī dīnām etāṃ vyacintayat |
aho vastuni mātsaryam aho bhaktir avastuni |
nādyāpyeko .pi me jāto jātau tv asyāṃ yamāvimau ||
evaṃ saṃcintayantī ca sā devī snānakāṅkṣiṇī |
snapitā dattavastrā ca tābhiḥ svādu ca bhojitā |
samāśvastā ca sā yuktyā kathālāpaiḥ parīkṣitum |
bho brāhmaṇi kathā kācit tvayā naḥ kathyatām iti |
tacchrutvā sā tathetyuktvā kathāṃ vaktuṃ pracakrame ||
vaṇijāṃ tu kulastrīva sthirā lakṣmīr ananyagā ||
tasmād vivāhaṃ putrasya karomi vaṇijāṃ gṛhāt |
iti niścitya putrasya kṛte vavre sa bhūpatiḥ |
pūrayāmāsa ca tathā ratnair jāmātaraṃ sa tam |
sa vaṇig vasudattas tāṃ nināya svagṛhaṃ sutām ||
tato .kasmāt sa nṛpatir jayadatto divaṃ yayau |
udbhūya gotrajais tasya tacca rājyam adhiṣṭhitam ||
tadbhītyā tasya tanayo jananyā nijayā niśi |
tatpārśvaṃ vraja rājyaṃ te sādhayiṣyati vatsa saḥ |
ityuktaḥ sa tadā mātrā rājaputro jagāda tām ||
tatra māṃ niṣparikaraṃ gataṃ ko bahu maṃsyate |
tacchrutvā punar apyevaṃ sā mātā tam abhāṣata ||
śvaśurasya gṛhaṃ gatvā tvaṃ hi prāpya tato dhanam |
iti sa prerito mātrā salajjo .pi nṛpātmajaḥ |
kramāt pratasthe sāyaṃ ca prāpa tacchvāśuraṃ gṛham ||
kṣaṇācca bhāryāṃ svām eva tāṃ ratnadyutibhāsvarām |
anvagād rājaputro .pi sa tāṃ guptam avekṣitum ||
sā cātra puruṣaṃ kaṃcid upāgāt puruṣo .pi tām |
tataḥ sā dviguṇībhūtarāgā pāpā prasādya tam |
puruṣaṃ tena sahitā tatra tasthau yadṛcchayā ||
tad dṛṣṭvā tu sa suprajño rājaputro vyacintayat |
kopasyāyaṃ na kālo me sādhyam anyaddhi vartate ||
śatruyogyaṃ striyām asyām asmin vā nṛpaśau mama ||
kim etayā kuvadhvā vā kṛtyam etaddhi durvidheḥ |
muktvā balibhujaṃ kākī kokile ramate katham ||
ityālocya sa tāṃ bhāryām upaikṣata sakāmukām |
satāṃ gurujigīṣe hi cetasi strītṛṇaṃ kiyat ||
tacca sā na dadarśaiva suratānte ca satvarā |
tasminn api gate kvāpi drutaṃ pracchannakāmuke |
mahārghaṃ ca tad ālokya rājaputraḥ sa tatkṣaṇam |
nirgatya siddhakāryaḥ san kānyakubjaṃ tato yayau ||
tatra bandhāya dattvā tat svarṇalakṣeṇa bhūṣaṇam |
krītvā hastyaśvam agamat sa pārśvaṃ cakravartinaḥ ||
taddattaiś ca balaiḥ sākam etya hatvā ripūn raṇe |
prāpa tat paitṛkaṃ rājyaṃ kṛtī mātrābhinanditaḥ ||
sāpi pūrvaparibhraṣṭaṃ cāritram iva vīkṣya tat |
buddhvā ca bhartrā prahitaṃ vyākulaiva samasmarat ||
idaṃ me patitaṃ tasyāṃ rātrau sattragṛhāntare |
yasyāṃ tatra sthito dṛṣṭaḥ sa ko.pi pathiko mayā ||
mayā tu sa na vijñātas tenedaṃ prāpi bhūṣaṇam ||
tatas tasyā rahasyajñāṃ pṛṣṭvā ceṭīṃ svayuktitaḥ |
tatpitā sa vaṇig buddhvā tattvaṃ tatyāja tacchucam ||
tad itthaṃ sāhase strīṇāṃ hṛdayaṃ vajrakarkaśam |
hariṇīva ca rājaśrīr evaṃ viplavinī sadā |
dhairyapāśena banddhuṃ ca tām eke jānate budhāḥ ||
tasmād āpadyapi tyājyaṃ na sattvaṃ saṃpadeṣibhiḥ |
ayam evātra vṛttānto mamātra ca nidarśanam ||
iti tasyā mukhācchrutvā brāhmaṇyās tatkṣaṇaṃ kathām |
iti saṃcintya devī tāṃ brāhmaṇīṃ punar abravīt ||
bhāryā tvaṃ kasya ko vā te vṛttāntaḥ kathyatāṃ tvayā |
tacchrutvā brāhmaṇī bhūyaḥ sātha vaktuṃ pracakrame ||
mālave devi ko .pyāsīd agnidatta iti dvijaḥ |
tasya ca svānurūpau dvāvutpannau tanayau kramāt |
sa bāla eva nirgatya gataḥ kvāpi yaśasvini ||
dvitīyaś ca sa tadbhrātā jyeṣṭho māṃ pariṇītavān |
tatkṣaṇaṃ tisṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ brāhmaṇībhir ahaṃ tataḥ |
deśabhaṅgād vidūraṃ ca gatvā deśaṃ tadanvitā |
aho apāvṛtaṃ dvāram āpadāṃ mama vedhasā ||
tad etayor gatir nāsti bālayor vardhanāya me |
mayā praviśya vatseśo rājā sadasi yācitaḥ |
vipadaś ca nivṛttā me dvārāt pratihatā iva ||
ityeṣa mama vṛttānto nāmnā piṅgalikāpy aham |
sa tu śāntikaro devi devaro me videśagaḥ |
prītyaināṃ brāhmaṇīṃ devī sā vitarkyaivam abravīt ||
vaideśikaḥ sa jāne .haṃ devaras te bhaviṣyati ||
ityuktvā brāhmaṇīm utkāṃ nītvā rātriṃ tadaiva tām |
iyaṃ te bhrātṛjāyeti brāhmaṇīṃ tām adarśayat ||
brāhmaṇīṃ bhrātṛjāyāṃ tāṃ ninye śāntikaro gṛham ||
yad etya labdhavibhavās tatra sarve .pi saṃgatāḥ |
bālakau tau tayoḥ sā ca mātā śāntikaraś ca saḥ ||
tato gacchatsu divaseṣv ekadā pañcabhiḥ sutaiḥ |
pañcaitasyāḥ suto .dyāpi naiko me sakhi dṛśyatām |
puṇyānām īdṛśaṃ pātram īdṛśyapi na mādṛśī ||
yuṣmādṛśeṣu jāyeta yaḥ sa ko .pyuttamo bhavet |
tad alaṃ tvarayā prāpsyasyacirāt svocitaṃ sutam ||
tad devi varado .vaśyam ārādhyaḥ sa śivo .tra naḥ ||
tasyām āttavratāyāṃ tu sa rājāpi samantrikaḥ |
trirātropoṣitau tau ca daṃpatī sa vibhus tataḥ |
uttiṣṭhataṃ sa yuvayoḥ kāmāṃśo janitā sutaḥ |
iti vacanam udīrya candramaulau sapadi tirohitatāṃ gate prabudhya |
adhigatavaram āśu daṃpatī tau pramadam akṛtrimam āpatuḥ kṛtārthau ||
utthāya coṣasi tataḥ prakṛtīr vidhāya tatsvapnakīrtanasudhārasatarpitās tāḥ |
devī ca sā narapatiś ca sabandhubhṛtyau baddhotsavau vidadhatur vratapāraṇāni ||
ko .pyatha devyā vāsavadattāyāḥ phalam upetya dadau ||
tataḥ sa viniveditasphuṭatathāvidhasvapnayā saha pramuditas tayā samabhinandito mantribhiḥ |
vicintya śaśimaulinā phalanibhena dattaṃ sutaṃ manoratham adūragaṃ gaṇayati sma vatseśvaraḥ ||
prabuddhā sevituṃ sākṣāt tad evābhilalāṣa sā |
taṃ ca dohadam etasyā devyā yaugandharāyaṇaḥ |
vijahāra ca sā taistaiḥ prayogair gaganasthitā |
tasyāḥ sarveṣu śṛṇvatsu nijagāda kathām imām ||
na kevalaṃ girīṇāṃ yo gurur gaurīpater api ||
tad aputrāya me dehi deva putraṃ guṇānvitam ||
tacchrutvā sa prahṛṣṭaḥ san kalpavṛkṣaṃ praṇamya tam |
gatvā nivedya tad rājā nijāṃ devīm anandayat ||
atha tasyācirād eva rājñaḥ sūnur ajāyata |
jīmūtavāhanaṃ taṃ ca nāmnā sa vidadhe pitā ||
jānāmi tāta yad bhāvā bhave .smin kṣaṇabhaṅgurāḥ |
sthiraṃ tu mahatām ekam ākalpam amalaṃ yaśaḥ ||
paropakṛtisambhūtaṃ tad eva yadi hanta tat |
kim anyat syād udārāṇāṃ dhanaṃ prāṇādhikapriyam ||
lolā kvāpi layaṃ yāti yā parānupakāriṇī ||
tad eṣa kalpaviṭapī kāmado yo .sti naḥ sa cet |
parārthaṃ viniyujyeta tadāptaṃ tat phalaṃ bhavet ||
iti vijñāpya pitaraṃ tadanujñām avāpya saḥ |
deva tvaṃ śaśvad asmākam abhīṣṭaṃ phaladāyakaḥ |
tad ekam idam adya tvaṃ mama pūraya vāñchitam ||
kanakaṃ bhūtale bhūri nananduś cākhilāḥ prajāḥ ||
tataḥ sambhūya yuddhāya kṛtabuddhiṣu teṣu ca |

column3: tasmāt tāta mayā naiva yoddhavyaṃ gotrajaiḥ saha ||
rājyaṃ tyaktvā tu gantavyam itaḥ kvāpi vanaṃ mayā |
āsatāṃ kṛpaṇā ete mā bhūt svakulasaṃkṣayaḥ ||
mayāpi putra gantavyaṃ kā hi vṛddhasya me spṛhā |
rājye tṛṇa iva tyakte yūnāpi kṛpayā tvayā ||
evam uktavatā sākaṃ sabhāryeṇa tatheti saḥ |
tatsvasāraṃ ca so .paśyad ekānte jātu kanyakām |
tām ahaṃ te prayacchāmi mamecchāṃ mānyathā kṛthāḥ ||
yuvarāja mamābhūt sā bhāryā pūrve .pi janmani ||
tvaṃ ca tatraiva me jāto dvitīyaṃ hṛdayaṃ suhṛt |
tataś cādhaḥ sthitastatra krīḍan gauryā samaṃ haraḥ |
prāpya vidyādharīṃ bhāryāṃ niyojya svapade sutam |
evaṃ niśamya śāpāntam uktvā śarve tirohite |
vasudattābhidhānaḥ san vṛddhiṃ ca gatavān aham ||
tato māṃ mocayitvaiva vadhāt sa śabarādhipaḥ |
maivaṃ kṛthāḥ prasannāsmi tava yācasva māṃ varam |
ityukto divyayā vācā prahṛṣṭaś ca jagāda saḥ ||
evam astviti śāntāyāṃ vāci māṃ śabaro .tha saḥ |
mṛtyor mukhāt pravāsācca tataḥ pratyāgate mayi |
tatkṣaṇaṃ pitur āvedya vijñapya ca mahīpatim |
ānīya ca gṛhaṃ prītyā pūrṇaṃ saṃmānitaś ciram ||
nidhāya mayi pallīṃ svāṃ prāyāt sa śabarādhipaḥ ||
tataḥ sātiśayaṃ prāptuṃ muktāsāraṃ sa matkṛte |
dṛṣṭvā ca vismayākrāntaḥ śabaraḥ sa vyacintayat |
keyaṃ syād yadi martyastrī tat kathaṃ siṃhavāhanā ||
atha divyā kathaṃ dṛśyā mādṛśaistad iyaṃ dhruvam |
anayā yadi mittraṃ taṃ yojayeyam ahaṃ tataḥ |
kāpyanyaiva mayā tasya kṛtā syāt pratyupakriyā ||
tad etām upasarpāmi tāvaj jijñāsituṃ varam |
ityālocya sa mittraṃ me śabarastām upāyayau ||
taṃ ca dṛṣṭvāntikaprāptaṃ śabaraṃ sā kṛtānatim |
iti pṛṣṭavatīṃ tāṃ ca śabaraḥ pratyuvāca saḥ ||
tvāṃ ca dṛṣṭvādhunātmīyo devi prāṇapradaḥ suhṛt |
sa hi tvam iva rūpeṇa yauvanena ca sundari |
sā dhanyā kanyakā loke yasyāsteneha gṛhyate |
tat tvadākṛtir eṣā cet tādṛśena na yujyate |
vyarthaṃ vahati tat kāmaḥ kodaṇḍam iti me vyathā ||
uvāca taṃ ca śabaraṃ preryamāṇā manobhuvā |
kva sa te suhṛd ānīya tāvan me darśyatām iti ||
tacchrutvā ca tathetyuktvā tām āmantrya tadaiva saḥ |
sarvaiḥ puraskṛtastatra praviśya prābhṛtaṃ ca tat |
utsavena ca yāte .smin dine rātrau sa me rahaḥ |
ehi tatraiva gacchāva ityuktvā ca samutsukam |
mām ādāya niśi svairaṃ sa prāyācchabarādhipaḥ ||
prātaś ca māṃ gataṃ kvāpi buddhvā saśabarādhipam |
ahaṃ ca prāpito .bhūvaṃ kramāt tena tarasvinā |
tacca prāpya saraḥ sāyaṃ snātvā svāduphalāśanau |
ahaṃ ca sa ca tām ekāṃ vane tatroṣitau niśām ||
saṭālasiṃhapṛṣṭhasthā subhrūr dṛṣṭā mayā ca sā |
